lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

value.contract: Non-activating owning map, inherited cancellation and exactly-once tracked async children keep the database open until quiet. Untagged provider URI remains active-UI scoped even inside a background Scope; tagged URI resolves only its live owner, with no expired-token fallback. Broadcast ownership uses map path separately. A service delivery has its own reserve/claim/release ticket; only unclaimed delivery expires after 60 seconds, not every claimed child. Global operation lease identity is not the background database binding. Per-account recovery ACK precedes final cleanup and full-project clock; those commit boundaries and UID/path/mapName/token keys must not be treated as interchangeable or migrated implicitly.
